<style>
  .pagehead { position: relative; padding-top: calc(var(--nav-h) + clamp(60px, 9vw, 120px)); padding-bottom: clamp(50px, 7vw, 96px); background: radial-gradient(120% 130% at 22% 0%, var(--field-bg) 0%, var(--surface) 50%, var(--surface) 100%); overflow: hidden; }
  .pagehead .wrap { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .pagehead h1 { color: var(--ink); margin: 22px 0 24px; max-width: 18ch; }
  .pagehead .lead { max-width: 54ch; }
  .ph-eye { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -10%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 900px; height: 900px; z-index: 1; opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }
  .ph-eye circle { fill: none; stroke: var(--line-gold); stroke-width: 0.6; }

  .meaning { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: clamp(34px, 6vw, 90px); align-items: center; }
  .eye-mark { max-width: 360px; margin-inline: auto; width: 100%; }
  .eye-mark circle, .eye-mark ellipse { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent-fill); }
  .eye-mark .ring { stroke: var(--line-gold); stroke-width: 1; }
  .eye-mark .iris { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-fill) 14%, transparent); stroke-width: 1.2; }
  .eye-mark .pupil { fill: var(--surface); stroke-width: 1.2; }
  .eye-mark .scan { stroke: var(--accent-fill-hover); stroke-width: 1.4; transform-origin: 130px 130px; animation: spin 14s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  .meaning h2 { margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .meaning p { color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.12rem; margin-bottom: 20px; max-width: 52ch; }
  .meaning p .lead-word { font-family: var(--serif); font-style: italic; font-size: 1.3em; color: var(--accent-ink); }

  .stat-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 1px; background: var(--line); border-block: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .sb { background: var(--surface); padding: clamp(34px, 5vw, 56px) 28px; }
  .sb .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem); color: var(--accent-ink); line-height: 1; }
  .sb .l { font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--ink-muted); margin-top: 12px; line-height: 1.45; }

  .approach-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .ap { padding: clamp(30px, 4vw, 48px); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); transition: background 0.5s var(--ease); }
  .ap:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, var(--surface)); }
  .ap .k { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--accent-ink); letter-spacing: 0.15em; }
  .ap h3 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 16px 0 12px; }
  .ap p { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 0.98rem; }

  .team-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 360px; gap: clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px); }
  .member { }
  .avatar { aspect-ratio: 4/5; background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--field-bg), var(--surface)); border: 1px solid var(--line); position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  .avatar img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center top; display: block; }
  .avatar .mono { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.4rem); color: var(--accent-ink); opacity: 0.85; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
  .avatar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(60% 60% at 50% 35%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-fill) 8%, transparent), transparent 70%); pointer-events: none; }
  .avatar .ring-deco { position: absolute; width: 150%; height: 150%; border: 1px solid var(--line-gold); border-radius: 50%; left: -25%; bottom: -75%; }
  .member h3 { font-size: 1.45rem; margin: 22px 0 4px; color: var(--ink); }
  .member .role { font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-ink); }
  .member p { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-top: 14px; }

  @media (max-width: 880px) {
    .meaning, .approach-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .team-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 360px; }
    .stat-band { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    .eye-mark { max-width: 260px; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 560px) { .stat-band { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
</style>
